transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, November 7. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Diwali bonanza for D-street: Sensex logs best pre-festival rally in 35 yrs. In a significant market rally, the Sensex gained over 8.8 percent as foreign investors resumed buying Indian stocks. This surge followed the US midterm elections, which boosted hopes for policy stability and reduced crude prices. Major gains were seen in companies like Mahindra and Mahindra, Bajaj Finance, and HDFC Bank. The rupee strengthened to a two-month high against the US dollar during this period. Louisiana woman's lawsuit over uncle's sale of 300-acre inheritance revived. A Louisiana woman accused her uncle of transferring interests in nearly 300 acres of her late mother's estate to himself and businesses linked to him. More than 23 years after her mother's death, an appeals court revived her claims concerning his handling of the estate but upheld the dismissal of other claims. It also cancelled a $10,000 damages award and ordered further proceedings. 'Severe' season in Delhi: GRAP III in force as air quality plummets. GRAP III was activated in New Delhi as the air quality index continues to deteriorate significantly. The average AQI reached 382 at 4pm on Friday, prompting precautionary measures to be implemented. Areas throughout the city are already reporting severe air quality levels, particularly Punjabi Bagh and DTU. In response, certain restrictions on vehicles and construction activities have been enforced. 'Voices in head said to kill Trump': Man with firearms arrested near White House. The Secret Service took Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos into custody after he exhibited alarming conduct in his vehicle. When confronted by officers, he insisted that he heard voices commanding him to execute President Trump. A subsequent search of his stolen car revealed three guns and additional ammunition. A Venezuelan national without legal status since March 2024, Chrinos now underscores the persistent dangers faced by the president. Trump's corporate allies, Pakistan links in focus as Democrats prepare probe blitz. MAGA boss Donald Trump often boasted that Silicon Valley CEOs and corporate titans were falling over themselves to "kiss my ass" as they sought administration patronage. Ankur Warikoo shares 3 money rules he follows for his retired parents. Entrepreneur Ankur Warikoo shares his approach to supporting his elderly parents financially, emphasizing the blend of assistance and autonomy. He sponsors their travels to destinations they love, provides a regular monthly allowance for their expenses, and upgrades their mobile phones every two years. This balanced strategy showcases how financial help can also empower parents to maintain their independence and enjoy life. Ex-LA deputy gets 67 months for smuggling heroin in Pringles cans. Former Los Angeles County sheriff's deputy Michael Meiser has been sentenced to 67 months in federal prison for attempting to smuggle 1.1 pounds of heroin worth approximately $226,000 into a California jail. Prosecutors said Meiser concealed the drugs inside two Pringles cans and accepted $16,500 in cash and digital payments for the smuggling operation. Trump celebrates Diwali at White House with Indian diaspora, receives Hanuman Chalisa. US President Donald Trump participated in a Diwali celebration at the White House on Friday, which brought together prominent members of the Indian diaspora, including Indian entrepreneur Vishal Gondal, Michelin-starred chef Vikas Khanna and former Canadian parliamentarian Ruby Dhalla. Elon Musk: Tesla to end Texas Cybertruck production to make way for Cybercab. Elon Musk announced that Tesla will reduce Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to increase Cybercab output. Sales of the Cybertruck have been significantly below initial forecasts, prompting this decision. The Cybertruck faced multiple recalls and price adjustments since its launch in late 2023. Regulatory scrutiny is ongoing for the Cybercab, Tesla's centerpiece in its autonomous vehicle strategy. How Palmer Luckey turned a $2 billion Oculus sale into a $61 billion empire. At 24, Palmer Luckey had already experienced the kind of business success that many technology founders spend decades pursuing. Hyderabad student builds rupees 68,000 satellite receiver for remote villages. Aagam Jain, a passionate student from Hyderabad, has engineered an innovative device named SummitSathi. This unique satellite receiver delivers essential weather updates without needing an internet connection, making it perfect for remote Himalayan villages. Plans are underway to introduce three units across ten villages in the Seraj Valley, significantly enhancing access to crucial weather data.
